parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const finance=rows.filter(r=>String(r.workflowData?.name||r.workflowName||'').startsWith('Finance ·')); const failed=finance.filter(r=>['error','crashed','canceled'].includes(String(r.status).toLowerCase())); const running=finance.filter(r=>['new','running','waiting'].includes(String(r.status).toLowerCase())); return [{json:{status:failed.length?'ATTENTION':running.length?'RUNNING':'OK',execution_count:finance.length,failed_count:failed.length,running_count:running.length,failures:failed.map(r=>({id:r.id,workflow:r.workflowData?.name||r.workflowName,status:r.status,startedAt:r.startedAt})),checked_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
